optimized_configuration.name: 18-H Optimized AutoForge
optimized_configuration.description: Critical-path optimized AutoForge for M1+HP distributed topology

optimizations_applied.name: Build-Inference Overlap
optimizations_applied.impact: Saves 5.9s by running Maven build concurrently with LLM inference

optimizations_applied.name: Warm Model Preload
optimizations_applied.impact: Eliminates cold-TTFT penalty. 7.2s preload saves 15-18s on first calls

optimizations_applied.name: Keep-Alive Inference Calls
optimizations_applied.impact: Reduces per-call TTFT from ~17s to ~1s for subsequent calls

improvement_over_run8.ttft_improvement: Cold TTFT eliminated by warm preload + keep-alive

target_d.notes: Not achievable on current hardware without model changes

remaining_bottleneck.primary: LLM inference latency - 6 calls take 68.3s (73% of critical path)
remaining_bottleneck.secondary: Repair cycle - 12s for 2 repair cycles with RAG + LLM
remaining_bottleneck.tertiary: Build time - 6-9s, already optimized, mostly parallel slack

next_highest_value_optimization.risk: Combining design notes may reduce quality

conclusion: Optimized configuration achieves 364,953 NLOC/hr delivery-inclusive (11.7% above 18-G baseline, 2.15x commercial baseline). Critical path dominated by LLM inference (73%). Further optimization requires reducing LLM calls or improving per-call TPS.
